title: Flowers That Guide the Dead
description: Cempasúchil flowers (Tagetes erecta) bloom at sunrise in San Pedro Cholula, Mexico. The flowers are traditionally believed by the Mexican people to guide the souls of the dead back from Mictlán, the Aztec underworld, to their families during Día de los Muertos.
translated_description: 万寿菊（学名：Tagetes erecta）在墨西哥圣佩德罗乔卢拉的日出时分绽放。墨西哥人传统上相信，在亡灵节期间，这种花能指引亡者的灵魂从阿兹特克冥界米克特兰回到家人身边。
